entries.german: Hieronymus Öfner an Albrecht von Adeltzheim. Gütlicher Vergleich im Streit zwischen Rothenburg und Zeisolf von Rosenberg.
entries.english: Hieronymus Öfner to Albrecht von Adelsheim. Amicable settlement in the dispute between Rothenburg and Zaisolph von Rosenberg.

facts.content: was involved in a dispute with Rothenburg that Hieronymus Öfner helped settle amicably.
